symptom: A response already persisted as authoritative remained resume-eligible even if later-recorded evidence established that its Human Task had been superseded before response receipt.
root_cause: Response validity was checked only at insert time. Recovery did not recompute authority against lifecycle facts visible at the requested recorded-time boundary.
early_signals: reject_stale_human_response only evaluates lifecycle rows present before response INSERT
load_human_task_bundle previously returned the latest response without lifecycle adjudication
Trusted Memory already models valid time and recorded time separately
human_cost: No human intervention required to detect or remediate. Without the control, late-arriving evidence could leave an obsolete authorization executable.
prevention_rule: Resolve Human Task response authority bitemporally at recovery time; preserve invalidated responses as history but exclude them from resume.
automated_detection: SCN-034 PostgreSQL late-recorded backdated revocation regression test.
